meta.verificationPolicy: Three states, computed from the fields and never hand-typed. VERIFIED: source is a URL and a human opened it on lastVerified. UNVERIFIED: source starts with 'UNVERIFIED — ' and lastVerified is empty, because the numbers could not be traced to a source. STALE: patchVersion is behind meta.gameVersion. Every node re-checked in the 2026-09-11 pass carries that date because that is the day it was checked — a single verification pass cannot honestly produce a spread of dates, so the spread will only appear as nodes are re-checked on later days.
meta.patchNotesArchive: docs/sources/v271-patch-notes.md — intended local archive of the v.271 notes, because the Nexon page is a JS SPA that returns no text to a fetcher. NOT YET PRESENT in this repo as of 2026-09-11; check before citing it.
meta.verifier: tools/verify-graph.ts — runs on prebuild; a graph that fails any check fails the build.

nodes.title: How to use this guide
rows: Every section is a node in data/guide-graph.json: id, tab, title, tags, type, headers, rows, notes, source, lastVerified, patchVersion.

Three states, and they are computed from those fields rather than typed. VERIFIED: source is a URL and a human opened it on lastVerified. UNVERIFIED: source starts with 'UNVERIFIED — ' and lastVerified is empty. STALE: patchVersion is behind the live game version.

An UNVERIFIED node is not a wrong node — it is a node whose numbers nobody here could trace to a source. Before 2026-09-11 every node in this file carried the same hand-typed date and was badged current if the words 'patch notes' happened to appear in its source field.

tools/verify-graph.ts runs on every build and checks: source is a URL or explicitly unverified, dates parse and are not all identical, percentage rows in tables tagged 'rates' sum to 100, a cumulative column equals the running sum of its per-step column, the cross-node assertions below hold, and meso amounts have not drifted away from lib/rules.ts.

The assertions array at the top of the file ties prose to arithmetic. The 'symbol income doubled' sentence in start.v271 is recomputed from symbols.income and symbols.arcane.cost on every build, so it cannot silently go wrong again — it already did once, claiming 3-4 weeks where the tables say 7.4.
Numbers are GMS Heroic (Reboot). Where a figure is only known from KMS it says so and is not treated as GMS-confirmed — Reboot has no trading, and KMS balance is not GMS balance.
Read changelog.limitations before trusting any single number. It lists, by node id, everything this guide knows it cannot back.
nodes.source: UNVERIFIED — describes this file and its verifier, not the game; there is nothing external to cite.

nodes.title: What v.271 changed that actually matters
rows: Arcane River daily 20 -> 40 symbols; weekly 40 -> 80 per area
Arcane symbol income doubled: 360/area/week vs 180. At 2,679 symbols to max one, that is ~7.4 weeks per area down from ~14.9 — run all six areas in parallel.
Grandis daily: Cernium 20 -> 30, other areas 10 -> 15, Grand Sacred 10 -> 15
Sacred symbol grind shortened the same way (Grand Sacred areas not named in the notes — see symbols.income)
EXP to level cut sharply for Lv. 210-259 (per-band percentages are KMS figures — see training.exp)
The old 240s wall is largely gone. Pushing to 260 for 6th job is far faster
Star Catching removed; its success bonus is now applied permanently
No more minigame. Also means any quest asking for 'star catching' just needs successes
Bonus Stats can be reset with 3,000,000 mesos at Black Rebirth Flame rates
Reflaming is now dirt cheap. Fix bad flames immediately
Powerful / Eternal / Black Rebirth Flames NO LONGER drop from bosses or elites
Stop hoarding boss flames. Use the meso reset instead
New Burning Rebirth Flame + Karma version: Legion Coin Shop, Monster Collection, Mu Lung Dojo shop
Dojo and Legion coins are now flame sources
3rd HEXA Common Node added for all classes — the Bowman line reportedly gets HEXA Fury of the Wild (node name UNCONFIRMED)
New node to budget Sol Erda for at 260+
Exploration is Lv. 200+ only, rewards up to 10x per day per account
Worth doing daily; a flame source now
Attack Reflect removed from Zakum, Hilla, Von Leon, Horntail, Arkarium, Pink Bean, Cygnus, Ranmaru, Akechi
Daily bosses are much safer to burst down
Extracting Lv. 160+ gear yields more Superior Item Crystals; Lv. 200+ more again
Extract spare Absolab/Arcane instead of vendoring
Pocket Item slot usage requirements removed
Free stat if your pocket slot was gated
Special Skill Rings rebalanced; extra Special Skill Ring slot added (needs Ring of Restraint or Continuous Ring Lv. 4+)
Two ring effects at once now. Lv. 5/6 rings reduced to Lv. 4 with compensation
Sunday's Growth Box now gives 3x EXP Coupon Vouchers (10 -> one 3x EXP Coupon)
Better EXP economy from Monster Park
nodes.source: https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/update/44597/v-271-maple-story-x-frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-patch-notes — Nexon, 2026-09-10 · https://orangemushroom.net/2026/03/23/kms-ver-1-2-413-maplestorys-23rd-anniversary-maple-attack/ — Orange Mushroom's Blog, 2026-03-23
nodes.notes: Corroborated line by line on 2026-09-11: the symbol quest increases, the Lv. 210-259 EXP cut as a range, Star Catching removal, the 3,000,000 meso bonus-stat reset at Black Rebirth Flame rates, and Powerful/Eternal/Black Rebirth Flames no longer dropping from bosses and elites. Carried over from the initial build and NOT individually corroborated: the attack-reflect removals, extraction crystal yields, the pocket slot change, the Special Skill Ring rebalance, the Monster Park Growth Box change, the Monster Collection change, and the specific HEXA node name. The Nexon page is a JS SPA and returns nothing to a fetcher, so each claim was checked through a search index instead; KMS ver. 1.2.413 is the upstream patch and carries the same wording.

nodes.notes: WHAT THIS NODE DOES NOT TELL YOU, AND WHY. The gate costs above are sourced. The number that actually sets your timeline — Traces of Darkness earned per boss, per difficulty, per week — is not published in any source this guide could read, so it is not in this table and no weeks-to-complete is derived from it. What is quotable: the MapleStory Wiki puts the questline at 14 quests and a minimum of 11 weeks without Genesis Passes or Boss Reset Tickets, with entry gated on clearing the Black Mage in Story Mode and finishing the Lv. 255 Limina questline (read through a search index on 2026-09-11; the wiki returns 403 to automated fetches). The community tracker cited alongside models a trace bank of up to 3,000. FOR THIS ACCOUNT AT LV. 244: the gates are not the constraint — Verus Hilla and the Hard-tier clears are, and gear.tiers puts this character several armour tiers short of them. Liberation is the right long-term target and the wrong next purchase. The gate ORDER is as the cited tracker lists it; the in-game quest order may differ and was not confirmed. The liberation currency in GMS is Traces of Darkness — no row here claims it is anything else.

nodes.title: Star Force success / boom table
nodes.notes: Since v.264 items can no longer LOSE stars on failure — only success, fail, or boom. This is the Enhancement Mode 1 column: v.269 (2026-06-17) added modes 1-4 for taps from 15 to 21 star, where higher modes cut the destruction rate for more mesos and mode 4 cannot boom at all. The per-mode rates are not published anywhere citable — see starforce.cost. Every row was re-checked against the cited DigitalTQ table on 2026-09-11 and each sums to 100.
nodes.source: https://www.digitaltq.com/maplestory-star-force-guide — DigitalTQ, updated 2026-02-20 · https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/update/41138/v-269-ride-the-lightning-patch-notes — Nexon, 2026-06-30

nodes.title: Rules, caps and safeguards
rows: Special caps: Tyrant gear = 15 stars. Sweetwater = 15 stars. Superior equipment uses its own harsher table.
Boom risk begins at 15 stars. Below 15 you cannot destroy an item.
Safeguard doubles the meso cost and removes boom. Available up to 18 stars only.

Enhancement Mode, added in v.269: tapping from 15 to 21 stars you choose a mode 1-4. Mode 1 is the standard rate and cost. Modes 2 and 3 lower the destruction rate for more mesos. Mode 4 is 0% destruction. Mode 4 is not offered from 15 to 17 stars because it would equal Safeguard there.
The per-mode success, destruction and cost numbers are not published in any source this guide could cite. Do not let a calculator tell you otherwise — see starforce.cost.
v.271 REMOVED Star Catching. Its success bonus is now applied automatically to every attempt.
Meso cost scales with item level and current star count. Cubing cost is flat; star force cost is not. The formula shape is in starforce.cost.
Booming leaves a Trace item. Restore it onto a fresh copy of the same item via Trace Transfer.
Trace recovery: boomed at 15-19 returns 12 stars, 20 returns 15, 21-22 returns 17, 23-25 returns 19, 26-30 returns 20.
Star Force Transfer: same equip type, same job type, within 10 item levels. You keep (stars - 1).
Transfer trick: star a cheap common item, then transfer into the rare one. Potential does NOT transfer — only stars.
nodes.source: https://www.digitaltq.com/maplestory-star-force-guide — DigitalTQ, updated 2026-02-20 · https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/update/41138/v-269-ride-the-lightning-patch-notes — Nexon, 2026-06-30
nodes.notes: Caps, safeguard, trace recovery and transfer were re-read from the cited DigitalTQ guide on 2026-09-11; that guide was last updated 2026-02-20 and still describes Star Catching, which v.271 removed, so it is stale on that one point and this node is not. lib/rules.ts parses the Safeguard and Trace recovery lines out of this node by text — do not reword them without changing the parser.

nodes.title: Star force meso cost: the formula, and what is missing from it
rows: cost = 100 x round( L^3 x (star+1)^E / D ) + 10
item level rounded DOWN to a multiple of 10
Same — no Nexon table confirms these
DigitalTQ says Safeguard doubles the cost up to 18 stars; the calculator applies x2 only at 15-17. UNRESOLVED
NO VALUE — do not guess one
Mode costs are not published anywhere citable
every tap on a Heroic world
UNSOURCED. No source says Heroic costs match regular worlds; 1.0 is an assumption, not a finding
The v.271 notes do not mention star force costs. Absence of evidence, not evidence of absence
nodes.notes: THIS IS THE DENOMINATOR OF EVERY DAMAGE-PER-MESO QUESTION THIS APP EXISTS TO ANSWER, AND IT IS NOT SOURCED. Nexon publishes no meso cost table. The coefficients above were read on 2026-09-11 out of the source of a widely used community star force calculator: that is evidence of what the community implements, not a citation, and it is pinned to no particular game version. Sanity check you can do by hand: a Lv. 200 item at 0 stars gives 200^3 / 2500 = 3200, so 100 x round(3200) + 10 is about 320K mesos for the first tap. If the game charges something far from that, this table is wrong and should be marked so. Three inputs have no trustworthy value at all: the per-mode cost multipliers for Enhancement Modes 2-4, the Heroic-world multiplier (assumed 1.0), and any v.271 adjustment. Anything built on this node must carry that uncertainty into the UI and say so — a confidently wrong meso figure is worse than none, because it sends a real person to grind for a number that was never real. What would fix this: a per-star meso table for GMS Heroic at v.271, or Nexon's own enhancement cost disclosure.
nodes.source: UNVERIFIED — no Nexon-published meso cost table exists. Coefficients read from a community calculator's source on 2026-09-11: https://github.com/brendonmay/brendonmay.github.io/blob/master/starforceCalculator/serverDiffs.js — brendonmay star force calculator, undated. Enhancement Mode mechanics (not costs): https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/update/41138/v-269-ride-the-lightning-patch-notes — Nexon, 2026-06-30

nodes.title: Arcane Symbol upgrade cost
nodes.notes: All six maxed = 13,200 main stat and 1,320 Arcane Force. Symbol stat is FLAT — it is not multiplied by your %stat potential, which is why %stat lines are worth less than they look while your symbols are low. The cited DigitalTQ table omits the 19 -> 20 step (372 symbols) and therefore totals 2,307; 2,307 + 372 = 2,679 is the number to plan against, and assertion symbols.arcane.cost.cumulative-final checks that sum on every build. lib/rules.ts reads the last row's main stat and Arcane Force columns to derive stat-per-force — do not reorder the columns.

nodes.title: Bonus Stats after the v.271 revamp
rows: CHANGED in v.271: Bonus Stats can now be reset with mesos — 3,000,000 per reset — at Black Rebirth Flame rates.
You choose whether to keep the old or the new roll. Reflaming is now cheap enough to do on every piece you own.
MVP Gold and above can reset 3 times at once.
CHANGED in v.271: Powerful, Eternal and Black Rebirth Flames NO LONGER drop from Boss Monsters, Elite Monsters or Elite Champions.
New: Burning Rebirth Flame and Karma Burning Rebirth Flame. Reset rates match Powerful Rebirth Flames.
Burning Flame sources: Legion Coin Shop, Monster Collection exploration rewards, Mu Lung Dojo Point Shop.
Karma Black Rebirth Flame limit in the Legion Coin Shop raised from 40 to 60. Day 18 Daily Gift is now a Karma Black Rebirth Flame.
An item can hold at most 4 distinct bonus stats. There are 7 tiers per stat type.
Eternal Rebirth Flames roll tier 2 minimum, rarely tier 5. On flame-advantaged (boss) gear, tier 4 minimum, rarely tier 7.
CANNOT take bonus stats: Rings (except Secret Ring), Shoulders (except Scarlet Shoulder), Medals, Emblems, Badges, Androids, Android Hearts, Totems (except Ancient Slate).

nodes.title: HEXA Matrix (6th job, Lv. 260+)
rows: 6th job advancement at Lv. 260. Origin skill granted at Lv. 1 on advancement; Origin unlocks properly at 265.
Order of spend: HEXA Mastery node (red) -> HEXA Boost nodes (blue) -> HEXA Skill nodes -> HEXA Stat last.
HEXA Skill nodes max at Lv. 30 with meaningful breakpoints at 10, 20 and 30.
A HEXA Stat node costs 5 Sol Erda + 10 Sol Erda Fragments to create.
CHANGED in v.271: a 3rd HEXA Common Node was added. Explorer Bowman (Bow Master, Marksman, Pathfinder) gets HEXA Fury of the Wild.
Sol Erda Fragments are permanent and untradable — bank them on the character that will reach 260 first, even at low level.
v.271: Sol Erda and Sol Erda Energy are now consumed separately depending on whether they are untradable or world-tradable.

nodes.title: Update log
rows: Initial build from v.271 patch notes. Symbol income doubled, Lv. 210-259 EXP cut, Star Catching removed, Bonus Stat meso reset added, boss flames removed from drops, 3rd HEXA Common Node.

FIXED a claim this file's own tables contradicted: 'symbols roughly doubled, maxing is a ~3-4 week job' became '360/area/week vs 180; 2,679 symbols to max, so ~7.4 weeks per area down from ~14.9'. Both numbers are now recomputed by assertions on every build.
Every source became a URL or an explicit UNVERIFIED statement; every lastVerified became either 2026-09-11 (a human opened the cited page that day) or empty. 14 verified, 18 unverified.
Arcane total row made numeric (180 -> 360 per week) so assertions can read it. Grand Sacred row flagged UNCONFIRMED: the v.271 notes name Cernium and the five Sacred areas, not Tallahart or Geardock.
Kept. Added the DigitalTQ discrepancy (its table omits the 19 -> 20 step and totals 2,307 instead of 2,679) and an assertion that locks the sum.
Re-verified against DigitalTQ. Added Enhancement Modes 1-4 (GMS v.269, taps from 15 to 21 stars), which the initial build omitted entirely.
NEW. Formula shape and coefficients from a community calculator; Safeguard multiplier unresolved; mode and Heroic multipliers have no source. Shipped UNVERIFIED rather than guessed.
NEW. The 8 liberation gates and their 6,500 Traces of Darkness. No weeks-to-complete derived, because per-boss trace income is not published anywhere citable.

Arcane Umbra rewritten to the sourced per-piece rate (12 Butterfly + 108 Arcane River per armour piece; 24 + 216 for the weapon). The old '324 + 36 for a 5-set' was that arithmetic pre-multiplied and mislabelled.

Extended past Kalos with Kaling, Limbo, Baldrix and Jupiter (Geardock, GMS v.270). CP cells read 'no citable figure' because none exists. Node marked UNVERIFIED: 'Games Finder boss ranges' is undated and publishes no CP.
Kalos row corrected: the wiki gives 5 deaths in Easy/Normal and 8 in Chaos/Extreme, contradicting the carried-over claim that v.271 raised Easy/Normal to 8.
Coin rewards corrected per difficulty (Pennys at Easy/Normal, Coins at Hard/Hell). The 'party of 1-6' claim dropped: the cited guide says solo.
Marked UNVERIFIED. The per-band percentages are the KMS ver. 1.2.413 table; GMS v.271 confirms only that Lv. 210-259 was reduced.
Rewritten from the cited training guide. The 'take only 1 damage at 150% Arcane Force' claim dropped: not in the source.
Night Troupe dates added from a preview article and labelled as such. Node marked UNVERIFIED: event rewards were not corroborated.
NEW. Known limitations by node id — the equivalent of a per-item errata page.
